none: PAS CAM-AD7ED3: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Radiate
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy radiate, a contemporary copy, of Carausius (AD 286-293 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [PAX]/AVG. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch and vertical sceptre. Mintmark: [ ] O//[ ], probably based on F O //ML type of London - See RIC V, pt.2, p. 472, 101 for general type. Obverse legend reads IMP CARAV[SIVS ... ] (AV?). Obverse shows a radiate, draped and cuirassed…
